decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The habitable room hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the single-family dwelling known as 14 Worton Road, Isleworth. The building shall not be used for any commercial use or as a separate residential unit.
description: Retention of single storey rear and side extension and side extension and conversion of existing side garage to study room to house
